revisions.comment: FY27E EPS down ~21% from Jan-26 peak (~600) and ~19% over 12m; big steps after Q4 FY26 (May) and post-Q1 (Aug-Sep).

bull: GST 2.0 rate cut revived small cars (+34% YoY in Q1 FY27); first-time buyers up to 54%; domestic share +230bp to 41.2%.
Supply- not demand-constrained: ~130k order book, ~13 days dealer inventory; +500k capacity (Kharkhoda-2, Hansalpur line 4) to ~2.9mn units, full ramp in 4-5 months.
Export leadership: exports +28.6% YoY vs industry -8.4%; >55% of India PV exports, ~120 countries.
Q1 margin hit (~300bp commodities, of which ~110bp supplier settlement-cycle shift) viewed as transient; price hikes in June and August, aluminium off June peak.
Product cadence: new Brezza (~2,000 bookings/day), Victoris, eVitara, 2nd EV, 7-8 new SUVs by 2030; multi-powertrain (CNG ~40%, hybrid, EV).
Valuation de-rated: at ~11,050 stock trades ~19x consensus FY28E EPS (~594) vs brokers' 26-30x target multiples; consensus TP implies ~40% upside.
bear: Margins: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 8.2% (lowest ever, -350bp QoQ); recovery hinges on commodity prices, FX and settlement-cycle normalisation outside management control.
Persistent EPS downgrades: FY27E consensus EPS ~471 vs ~600 in Jan-26; FY27 profit growth seen at only ~1.9% (Trendlyne) despite ~15% revenue growth.
Citi Q2 preview expects EBITDA -11.6% YoY despite ~28% revenue growth - operating leverage not yet visible.
Order book fell to ~130k from ~190k QoQ; exports fell 5.3% YoY in July 2026; West Asia disruptions.
Rising SUV/EV competition may cap share gains and pricing; Nomura stays Neutral (TP 14,070).
Stock -22% since Q1 print to fresh 52-week lows below all major moving averages; FII holding drifted down (15.8% -> 12.8% over 4 quarters per ICICI/Elara shareholding tables).
